# proxmox_query_oci_repo_tags (Data Source)

Lists tags of an OCI repository through `/nodes/{node}/query-oci-repo-tags`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_query_oci_repo_tags" "t" {
  node      = "pve-1"
  reference = "docker.io/library/alpine"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `reference` (String)

### Read-Only

- `tags` (List of String)
